text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Very few Umamusume on the Triple Tiara tour have ever won the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And though the Takarazuka Kinen is also fast approaching, the spectators believe that Sweep Tosho might just manage to pull off a victory.
